entries.name: door
entries.prompt: Precise-object-edit. Image1 is EDIT TARGET: preserve its existing ivory outer frame EXACTLY including all dimensions, position, silhouette, color and perspective. Image2 is a STRICT INTERNAL PANEL GEOMETRY guide only. Replace ONLY Image1's inner pink leaf panel moldings with the FOUR exact parallelogram outlines from Image2. The guide's upper-panel LOWER edges are much steeper than the edit target: they MUST slope upward-to-right at 0.5, exactly parallel to the frame lintel/sill, NOT the shallow crooked old edges. Use all four corners from the guide for each panel. Do not retain old inner moldings. Make simple straight rose-pink raised moldings with cream recesses and a tiny centered rose, no wavy contour. Move gold handle to guide's gold dot position about (775,530), above original. Keep image1's old handle design. No changes whatsoever to the outer ivory frame. Preserve original 1254 square canvas, same object position and transparent background, no scaling or recropping. The output must be the original nostalgic pink door with only its panel layout/handle corrected using image2.

entries.name: fridge
entries.prompt: Precise-object-edit. Image1 is the EDIT TARGET, image2 is the EXACT geometric seam guide. Make ONE change only: replace image1's freezer/fridge seam on the left visible front face with a straight gold divider EXACTLY following image2's RED LINE, endpoints (307,565) and (627,725), slope 0.5, in the existing canvas. The current seam is too shallow; it must become visibly STEEPER descending right. It must be PARALLEL to the front face's top edge (307,390)->(627,550) AND its bottom edge (307,880)->(627,1040). Remove old shallow seam cleanly. Adjust adjacent cream door moldings and the lace immediately beneath to run parallel to the new seam. Each door is a true rectangle in the front plane with parallel opposite edges. Image2 red is a construction guide: final seam gold, not red. Keep image1's exact outer shape, dimensions, camera, transparency, top/side panels, all pink/gold/ribbon designs and handle style. Do not elongate, scale, recenter or deform the body. Keep 1254 square canvas and original location. All other parts unchanged.
